`al `m yghd lym `gc yde` ngia reld dxi fe kyxd el` rlzd larlim. (eiwx` c l`) (eiwx` c ld) "ektx rlie" el` rl gaxe yde` ngia gh`z kneze:

dtqg yyghe angyaz ypei dym. aio yypd yne lym fag `gx aio yypde lym glio tqel yp`nx (ynez ia kf) "e`nxzm fag tqg de` ld'". and caxim `nexim yyghe afnpe yde` iem `xard ryx apiqo `tle yghe aygxiz angyaz ypei dym tqel. `al `m yghe yl` afnpe angyad yl` lyne kyx. yl` lym arlie pryd kni y`io le arlim afnpe etqel:
tqg yyghe lyne a`xard ryx wcm gvez tqel lti y`ipe fnpe. raxd ypze eygh afnpe lym tqg eko dyegh y`x fagim lym tqg `tle ygho `gx gvez dxi `le kyxim el` rle larlim lym gead:

reld yyghd rl ni y`ipe ngia wxao kll l` rlzd larlim. ydxi yghd yl` lym arlid. e`s rl ti yfd yyghd lyne `ipe ngia klem arpipe. `i `tyx yl` idid gia ktxd lynim y`io lj `cm aiyx`l yl` rax nrelm rl nvez ryd:
reld da`d l`gx nizd yry`d yl` lym arlid rlzd larlim lym gead. y`io arlim l`gx nizd:
ypi kayi rvxz yygho lym `ilim l` rle lvaex lym gead. e`m cnd ydo `ilim eygho lym `ilim rle ldo. ntpi ydi` rwixd ahrez:
`ym nvxr yyghe yl` lyne. `e yl` pzo ncne rl bai adepez. hreo pqkim. y`m iwxa al` pqkim pnv` knwxia pcad e`io d`ym a` pcad:
kay da` rm drnx yyghe yl` lyne. l` iai` npgz pqkim yle ypi ryxepim `l` ryxeo `gc ky`x dpcaez. ydxi l` rld lym geaze. eko znic yyghe yl` lyne l` irld rne ypi bfxi rvim ky`x dznicim. ydxi l` rld lgeaz dznic `l` dxi de` kkl dpcaez:
ypi kayi rvxz yygho yl` lyno. `e yygho aio ltpi fnpo aio l`gx fnpo. dcm ifxw edayx i`kl `s rl ti yl` rle lvaex lym gead. e`m dizd yaz l` ifxw. e`m fxw dxvd ldwhix `inexio lrxa:
eko ylni pfix yygho yl` lyno `s rl ti yl` rle larlim dxi do p`klio liem elild e`ipo hrepio lgm. eko `ym pfix e`ym nvxr yygho yl` lyno `s rl ti yl` rle larlim dxi do p`klim:
kax a`xpe ydngya a`gz n`xar draecez ngyaz dnwem dwxao tqel e`ipe tbel. e`m gya ngyaz dfno dwxao tbel. and caxim `nexim ayl` rxa rm ngyaz dfno ngyad `gxz. `al `m rxa ngyaz nwem `e ngyaz ypei dym atqg eagh`z rm ngyaz dfno dwxao tqel e`ipe tbel. kivc. ygh ewal edelij efxw engyaze a`xar raecez `le ngyaz dfno. `e ydizd ngyaze a`gz n`xarzo ngyaz dfno eay`x draecez dizd ngyaze pkepd. `e l` dizd ym ngyad kll ay`x draecez. dxi fd tbel. `al `m ygh angyaz dfno ewal `e delij `e fxw angyaz dnwem. `e yygh angyaz dnwem ewal `e delij `e fxw angyaz dfno. dxi fd `ipe tbel `l` tqel alac. eko dtqg edgh`z yygho angyaz ypei dym ewal edelij angyaz dfno. `e yygho angyaz dfno ewal `e delij `e fxw angyaz ypei dym. `io fd tbel `l` tqel. ede` dcio aretez eanpgez. `io ym tbel `l` wxao yptql angyaz dfno el` rxa rnd ngyaz dnwem l` azgld el` aqes el` rxa rnd ngyaz ypei dym awxapez yptqlio angyaz ypei dym:
dngya a`gz n`xar draecez `e aklm l`kl kfiz ncax dx`ei l`kild ageu ekfiz lngx. `e kfiz lngx ekfiz ageu. `e kgvi fiz ageu ekgvi fiz lngx. `e kgvi fiz lngx ekgvi fiz ageu. dxi dwxao tqel e`ipe tbel. eko `m rxa dngyad adwhxd dxi fd tqel e`ipe tbel:
gya l`kl `e ldwhix kgvi fiz angyaz dnwem el`kl `e ldwhix kfiz angyaz dfno dxi fd tbel. aio ydwcim ngyaz kfiz aio y`gx `ezd. y`io gvi fiz gyea `vl kfiz:
gya rl gvi fiz angyaz dfno erl gvi fiz angyaz dnwem egfx egya rl gvi fiz `gx angyaz dfno dxi fd tbel. eko `m gya rl gvi fiz angyaz dfno egfx egya rl kfiz gvie angyaz dfno egvie angyaz dnwem dxi fd tbel:
gya rl dcnim dpzpio lnhd lzo `ezm lnrld `e rl dpzpio lnrld lzzm lnhd ekiev` angyaez `le y`ipo teqlio kne ya`xpe erxa rndo ngyaz dfno dxi fd tbel. e`m gya rndo ngyaz dnwem lacd dxi fd tqel e`ipe tbel:
gya rl dcm dpzo lnrld lzze lngx lnhd. `e rl dcm dpzo lnhd lzze lngx lnrld. `e ygya rl dcm dpzo atpim adikl lzze lngx anfag dgiveo. `e ygya rl dcm dpzo anfag dgiveo lzze lngx atpim adikl. `ipe tbel. `s rl ti ygya ngyaz dfno de`il eypd nwem pzipz dcm angyaze dxi fd tqel e`ipe tbel. en`gx ya`xpe adlkez `le ydcm ypzo yl` anwene k`le pzo anwene lnd l` idid fd tbel angyad fe ygya lzo dcm yl` anwene lngx. ntpi ydcm dpzo yl` anwene `s rl ti ydfag kyx `ipe nzix dayx a`kild kne ya`xpe. ekl fxiwd y`ipd nzxz dayx a`kild `m gya lzpd geu lfnpe l` tbl. ltikj `m gfx egya afag fd ngyaz dfno dxi fd tqel e`ipe tbel:
gya ngyaz fno ayrz wnivd `al l` ayrz lweh dlaepd. `e ygya ngyaz dfno ayrz lweh dlaepd `al l` ayrz wnivd. dxi fe tqeld e`ipd tbel rc yigya ngyaz dfno akl dnzix yde` dwnu rm dlaepd. ayrz wnivz dwnu elweh dlaepd. `e ayrz pzipz ypido akli. `e ayrz delkzo `e ayrz fxiwzo:
gya ayrz dwhxz dwnu yiwhix dlaepd lngx `ipd tbel y`io dwhxd ntblz dwhxd. eko `m dwhix dlaepd lacd `e dwnu lace ede` ngya l`kl yixim lngx dxi fe tqeld e`ipd tbel y`io ntblio agvi nzix. `al `m dwhix `z dwnu lace egya yiwhix laepd lngx e`gx kj dwhix dlaepd egya yi`kl dyixim lngx dxi fd tbel. ydxi tyhd ngyaz fno akl dnpgd:
dwhix kci ynym no dwnu rm dlaepd ede` ngya yi`kl kci ynym no dyixim lngx. rc ydylim kl dwnu rm dlaepd angyaz dfno. dxi fe tqeld e`ipd tbel. y`s rl ti ycxj `kild akj nrh nrh `io cxj dwhxd akj `l` dxi fe knpgd yl` dwhx wnvd:
npgz geh` `e npgz wp`ez ydid rlid laepd egya ad ngyaz dfno wcm yilwh dlaepd dxi fe tqeld e`ipd tbel. e`m `gx ylwh dlaepd gya rlid ngyaz dfno dxi fd tbel:
yixim ygqxe aio wnivd ldwhxd edwhix dwnu angyaz dfno dxi fd qtw `m pware ltbel edxi do tbel. `e l` pware e`ipe tbel:
kl dcnim dpzpio rl nfag dgiveo ypzo ndm nzpd x`yepd angyad pkepd. epzo nnzpd ypid e`ilj angyaz ypei dym `e angyaz dnwem `e ngyaz dfno. dxi fd ktx edxvd dwxao. e`m pzo `z dx`yepd angyaz dfno edylim dnzpez angyaz dnwem dxi fd tbel. ynzpd x`yepd di` drwx. `al kl dcnim dpzpio rl nfag dtpini de`il eklo nrkaio fd `z fd kne ya`xpe. `m pzo `gz ndo yl` kzwpd `l` dtqic ad dngyad `s rl ti ypzo kl dy`x kzwpo dfag tqel:
gya ax`yepd ngyaz dfno eyzw ay`x. `e ypzo klo kzwpo geu no d`gxepd ypzo angyaz dfno. dxi fd tqel. e`ipe tbel rc yifd angyaz dfno ydxi klm anzpd `gz do:
hailz `var acm dgh`ez dtpiniez ntblz. kivc. gya ayrz hailz `var acm ngyaz dfno dxi fd kngya ayrz dfid:
did renc arfxd egya ngyaz dfno agh`ez dpryez atpim acax dpryd atpim `ipe tbel. gya acax dpryd ageu dxi fd tbel:
kivc. did renc arfxd e`nx dxipi yegh ldfez cne lngx. `ipe tbel. yddfid ltpim adikl:
did renc adikl e`nx dxi `pi nfd lytj yixim lngx. `ipe tbel ydxi gya atpim acax dpryd ageu. `al `m did renc arfxd eygh ede` ngya lytj yixim lngx `e ldwhix `inexio lngx. dxi fd tbel. ydxi gya ageu acax dpryd ageu:
dzecd ntblz `z dlgm edlgm `ipe ntbl `z dzecd. kivc. dyegh `z dzecd ede` ngya yi`kl nayxd `e ifxw cnd `e yiwhix `inexid lngx. dfag rm dlgm tbel. `al `m gya l`kl no dlgm lngx dlgm lace tbel efag dzecd `ipe tbel:
eko dcio aypi kayi rvxz rm yzi dlgm da`ez rndo y`m gya ngyaz fno akayim pztble yzi dlgm. gya yi`kl nyzi dlgm lngx. yzi dlgm tbel edkayim `ipo tbel. gya a`gz n`xar draecez l`kl kfiz nayx dfag rm dlgm lngx. dlgm lace tbel edzecd `e dkayim `ipo tbel:
dnwhix ypi afiki laepd yrm lgm dtpim egya ayrz dwhxzo yi`kl lgm dtpim lngx. dxi dlgm tbel:
dyegh ypi kayi rvxz egya l`kl `gz nyzi dglez lngx yzidm tbel:
dwhix ypi dafikim ede` ngya l`kl `gc nypi dqcxim lngx. ypi dqcxim tbel:
eko `m gya ngyaz dfno a`gz nglez dzecd `e a`gz nglez npgz n`td dzpex. dxi kl dglez tbel:
`al `m phn`z `gz nyzi dglez `e `gc nypi dqcxim `e `gz nglez dzecd. aio ltpi fxiwd aio l`gx fxiwd. `ezd dgld e`eze dqcx `qex. edhdex ahdxze i`kl:
gya araecz `gc nypi dkayim yi`kl kfiz nyzi dlgm lngx. eko `m gya adwhxz `gc nypi dafikio yi`kl kfiz nlgm dtpim lngx. dxi dlgm tqel. e`ipe tbel rc yigya akl dnzix yde` raecz ypi dkayim edwhxz ypi dafikio:
ygh `gc egya l`kl gvi fiz ngld fe lngx eygh dypi egya l`kl gvi fiz ngld ypid lngx dxi `le nvhxtio ltbel. ede` dcio aypi dafikio rm ypi dqcxim:
gya a`gc nypi dkayim ngyaz dfno. eryd dypi angyad pkepd. fd yry`de angyaz dfno tbel edypi kyx:
ygh `gc ndo egya ayrz ygihze yi`kl nayx dypi lngx ypido kyxim y`io ngyaio nfd rl fd:
ypi kayi rvxz `io nwcyio `z dlgm `l` aygihd. kivc. yghm efxw cnm angyaz ypei dym l` wcy dlgm. ygho lyno efxw cnm yl` lyno dlgm wcey e`ipe wcey. ygho yl` lyno `s rl ti yfxw lyno l` wcy dlgm:
yzi dlgm yiv`e aio ygihd lfxiwd efxw cm dkayim angyaz dfno. pztble yzi dlgm `s rl ti ydo ageu. ydfxiwd nerlz liev` `s rl ti yrcio de` ageu:
kayi rvxz yygho lyno e`ac dlgm. `m fxw cno lyno dxi `le tqelio. fxw cno angyaz dfno `gx y`ac dlgm dxi `le qtw `m dzxe a`kild `e l` dzxe:
kl dngya ngyad y`ipd pkepd awcyim. dxi fd reax al` zryd ydxi de` `enx (eiwx` f ig) "l` igya":
nti dynerd lnce yakll cio fd yl` itqic dwcyim angyad. ydxi fd cend lnhil nem awcyim. e`s rl ti ko `ipe lewd y`io dngyad nryd:
kl wxao yp`nx yde` tqel aio yptql angyad aio anryd aio y`xr ae cax ytqle. kl d`ekl nnpe kfiz anfic lewd yp`nx (caxim ic b) "l` z`kl kl zerad":
nti dynerd lnce y`io dkzea nfdix `l` rl tqeli dnwcyio:
eko wcyim ydhl adm nem. d`ekl ndm kfiz lewd. dxi dm akll (caxim ic b) "kl zerad" rc yielc ldm nem `gx ei`kle aneno kne ya`xpe. ekl ytqele nqtw `io lewio rlie:
kl wxao ypztbl angyaz dfno kne ya`xpe kl d`ekl nnpe kfiz anfic gia kxz yp`nx (eiwx` f ig) "edpty d`klz nnpe repd zy`". e`m `kl nnpe aybbd nai` gh`z waerd:
`io giaio kxz `l` rl `kilz caxim ydzxe aio l`cm aio lnfag. `al `m `kl no dnzix rvne `ipe gia kxz `l` lewd k`ekl tqeli dnwcyio y`io adm tbel. kivc. npgd ypztbld. d`ekl kfiz nyixid anfic gia kxz. `al `m `kl no dwnu yld `e no dlaepd `ipe gia kxz. lti ydo do dnzixim `z dyixim l`cm. eko fag ypztbl. d`ekl kfiz nayxe `e n`inexie `e nayx dreld gia kxz. `al `m `kl kfiz no dcm `ipe gia rlie nyem tbel. ydcm nzix `z d`inexio lwxa lnfag ed`inexio nzixio `z dayx l`cm. ecm dreld nzix ayxd lnfag. ecm gh`z dres nzix ayxd lkdpim. ecm relz dres nzix ayxd lnfag. ecm gh`ez dpyxtez nzix `inexidm lnfag. ltikj giaio rl `inexido nyem tbel. dwnu edlaepd nzixio dyixim lkdpim. ypi kayi rvxz nzixio yzi dlgm lkdpim. eko ypi afiki laepd nzixio lgm dtpim lkdpim. `al caxim y`io ldm nzixio kbeo ayx gh`ez dpyxtez enpgez dpyxtez `ipo nztblio lrelm:
e`le caxim y`io giaio rlido nyem tbel lrelm. dwnu. edlaepd. edwhxz. edcm. ediio. aio iio da` rm dpqkim aio iio da` atpi rvne. enpgez dpyxtez klo ydxi `io ldm wnu ldzixo. kbeo npgz kdpim enpgz pqkim eayx gh`ez dpyxtez. eleb yno yl nvxr. e`m z`nx edl` cm d`ym nzixe. `ipe zlei ae ydxi `cm nai` `yne diem eleb `gx knd inim kne yiza`x anwene:
`qex ldezix nayx dwcyim l`gx fno `kilzo yp`nx awxao zecd (eiwx` ka l) "l` zezixe nnpe rc awx" ede` dcio ly`x dwcyim klm. ednezix `ipe lewd ydxi pzwe dkzea lryd yp`nx (ynez ia i) "edpzx nnpe rc awx a`y zyxte":
d`ekl kfiz nayx wcyim ypezx. anfic gia kxz, ayebb nai` gh`z waerd, yp`nx (eiwx` ih g) "e`klie repe iy` ki `z wcy d' gll epkxzd". en`inzi izgia kxz rl `kilz dpezx. `m wcyi wcyim dm, gia rlido n`gx yirld rnec dygx. e`m wcyim wlim dm, gia rlido nywirz dgnd yl iem ypi, yde` zglz dlild yl iem yliyi. ediko dfdix dkzea rl dtbel erl dpezx. anle`im. ydxi p`nx ym (ynez kh lb) "l` i`kl ki wcy dm" ldfdix rl kl ytqele awcy, yde` al` zryd rl `kilze:
edtbel edpezx nvhxtio fd rm fd lkfiz. ekl dtbelim edpezxio nvhxtio:
`qex lhn` `z dwcyim `e lqaa ldm hn`d ydxi teqlo. ednhn` `z dwcyim `ipe lewd. `al `cm hdex y`kl kfiz nwcyim yphn`e lewd. yp`nx (eiwx` f ih) "edayx `yx ibr akl hn` l` i`kl". ede` dcio ly`x dwxapez y`m `kl kfiz nlaepz dnpgd yphn`d `gx ypzwcyd akli lewd. `gc wcyim yphn`e ltpi ktxd `e l`gx ktxd. aio yphn`e a`a dhn`d `e aelc dhn`d yl caxi zexd. `al `m phn`e ahn`ez yl caxidm `ipe lewd rl `kilzo. `al nkio `eze nkz nxcez. e`ipe lewd `l` d`ekl `gx fxiwz cnim. `al `m `kl wcm fxiwd `ipe lewd nyem `ekl wcy hn`. `al nkio `eze nkz nxcez:
kl `cm yphn` hn`d ygiaio rlid kxz rl ai`z dnwcy, e`kl kfiz no dwcyim, aio awcy hdex aio awcy hn`. anfic dxi fd pzgia kxz, yp`nx (eiwx` f k) "edpty `yx z`kl nfag dylnim `yx ld' ehn`ze rlie epkxzd". e`m `kl aybbd nai` wxao reld eiexc. enpio y`ipe ncax `l` ahn`z dbes yp`nx (eiwx` f k`) "epty ki zbr akl hn` ahn`z `cm `e aadnd hn`d `e akl ywu hn` e`kl nayx fag dylnim `yx ld' epkxzd". ede` dcio ly`x wcyi nfag. ediko dfdix rl reo fd aielcz, ydxi p`nx ad (eiwx` ia c) "akl wcy l` zbr":
nti dynerd lnce yfe `fdxd lhn` yl` i`kl wcy wcm yihal. ed`ekl wcy `gx yhal wcm yirxa ynye wcm yiai` ktxze lewd. e`ipe gia kxz yp`nx (eiwx` f k) "ehn`ze rlie" rc yzdid kl hn`ze rlie:
did hn` ahn`ez yl caxidm `ipe lewd. e`io vxij lenx y`ipe gia kxz. `al nkio `eze nkz nxcez:
`ipe gia kxz rl wcy yiy le nzixio rc yi`kl nnpe `gx ywxae nzixie. `al `m `kl `z dayx wcm fxiwz dcm `ipe lewd nyem hn` y`kl `z dwcy. fd dkll kl yiy le nzixio `io giaio rlie nyem tbel `e nyem pezx `e nyem hn` rc yiwxae nzixie kdlkzo. ekl y`io le nzixio kieo ywcy akli giaio rlie nyem hn`d. `tle phn` dayx wcm yihn` d`ekl de`il ewxae dnzixio e`gx kj `kl gia kxz. eko `m `kl nayx gh`ez dpyxtez ede` hn` `gx ypfxw cnm dxi fd gia kxz:
kax pza`x lj y`s caxim y`io giaio rlido nyem tbel giaio rlido nyem pezx ehn`. kivc. caxim y`io ldm nzixio `io giaio rlido nyem tbel egiaio rlidm nyem pezx ehn`. eko dnzixio rvno `s rl ti y`io giaio rlidm nyem tbel kne ya`xpe giaio rlido nyem pezx ehn`. geu no dcm y`io giaio rlie lrelm `l` nyem cax `gc alac:
hn` y`kl `inexio gia kxz:
`kl tqg yl` pvld. elgni zecd yl` dexnd glzo. dxi fd gia kxz nyem hn`z dbes. `s rl ti y`ipo x`eiio lnd ydo. `i `tyx yizgia `cm rl `kild `gz nyem tbel enyem pezx. ydtbel de` dwxao yptql angyaz dfno e`ipe reld lym wxao el` pxvd kll. edpezx de` dpy`x nwxao ywxa knveze l`gx fno `kilze:

fag ypztbl. `e ypezx l`gx fnpe e`kl nnpe. no drex. `e no dnxw. `e no dzalio. `e no d`ll. `e no dnx`d. no dbicim eno dwxpim eno dhltim. no dvtxpim no dgxhm eno dpevd enaivi dres. `ipe gia kxz. eko hn` dbes y`kl caxim `le nwxao kyx `ipe gia kxz. `al nkio `eze nkz nxcez:
`kl no dylil. `e no dyli`. gia nyem tbel epezx ehn` k`ekl ny`x ayx dfag:
wcyi rke"m `io giaio rlidm nyem tbel epezx ehn`. eko cm dwcyim kne ya`xpe. eko dlaepd edwhxz edrvim `io giaio rlido kxz l` nyem tbel el` nyem pezx el` nyem hn`z dbes:
nvez ryd lyxs kl dwcyim yphn`e yp`nx (eiwx` f ih) "edayx `yx ibr akl hn` l` i`kl a`y iyxs". eko dpezx nvez ryd lyxte yp`nx (eiwx` f if) "edpezx nayx dfag aiem dyliyi a`y iyxs". eakll dpezx dtbel ekl tqeli dnwcyio dkl pyxtio:
